svg.title: NET-06 — Compact final scoreboard, network role variants
svg.desc: 1280 by 900 client. A short completed network result uses the same compact score-panel vocabulary as Local Play. Required wide fields use existing horizontal navigation. Hidden result, settings and round detail do not enlarge the primary viewport's height. Host actions are shown; Guest substitutes its existing Leave and waiting text. There is no large final window or fixed diagnostic-style outcome hierarchy.

g.text: Not saved to local statistics or Elo
ANNOTATIONS — not UI. Same interim-style panel as Local Play; width reflects required data, not a fixed full-window frame.
Primary height follows the two score rows. Existing result/settings/round detail scrolls in this viewport; no new tab or details UI.
One score strip throughout traversal; compact section/column headings distinguish detail. Complete identities and values remain accessible.
Guest: replace Host actions with centered Leave; add Waiting for host to return to lobby or end session above status lines.
Status/actions are actual network additions, not blank local reservations. Footer gaps, counter and notice follow the appearance owner.
Names remain neutral white; values/pipes yellow, Team fills and grouping unchanged. New pointer bounds must match moved controls.
